# UI Sound Library

> Procedural micro-UX sound library for interactive web applications. Zero audio files, zero dependencies, latency-free Web Audio API synthesis.

This library provides 45 copy-paste procedural sound effects synthesized directly in the browser with native Web Audio API oscillators, noise buffers, and dynamic biquad filters.

## Core Documentation

- [Overview & Quickstart](https://abhi-yo.github.io/sound-library/docs): Getting started with procedural UI sounds in under two minutes.
- [Sound Catalog](https://abhi-yo.github.io/sound-library/docs/sounds): Audition all 45 procedural sounds across 5 categories.
- [CLI Reference](https://abhi-yo.github.io/sound-library/docs/cli): How to scaffold sound functions directly into your project.
- [React & Next.js Guide](https://abhi-yo.github.io/sound-library/docs/guides/react): Reusable hooks, event handlers, and Next.js App Router patterns.
- [Vue & Svelte Guide](https://abhi-yo.github.io/sound-library/docs/guides/vue-svelte): Integration patterns for Vue 3 composables and Svelte runes.
- [Custom Sound Design](https://abhi-yo.github.io/sound-library/docs/guides/custom-sounds): How to design and synthesize your own micro-audio waveforms.

## Sound Catalog by Category

### 1. Interaction Sounds
Tactile response for buttons, dials, switches, and typing interactions.
- `tap`: 35ms sine pitch ramp (1800Hz → 700Hz) — Buttons, list selections
- `thud`: 50ms filtered sine lowpass (95Hz → 36Hz) — Primary actions, solid clicks
- `snap`: 25ms square wave burst — Physical toggles, checkboxes
- `pop`: 70ms sine resonant pitch drop (880Hz → 140Hz) — Dropdown open, menu reveal
- `tick`: 8ms square wave fast decay (4800Hz → 1100Hz) — Slider scrub, rotary dials
- `toggle-on`: 75ms sine upward glide (520Hz → 820Hz) — Switch ON state
- `toggle-off`: 75ms sine downward glide (820Hz → 520Hz) — Switch OFF state
- `shutter`: 80ms dual noise + sine transient — Screenshot, camera action
- `keystroke`: 60ms bandpass noise clack (4200Hz) — Mechanical keyboard simulation
- `bloop`: 90ms liquid sine pitch drop (600Hz → 150Hz) — Playful buttons, reactions
- `sub-kick`: 160ms sub-bass pitch drop (150Hz → 40Hz) — Major action confirmations
- `haptic-pop`: 35ms square wave pulse (120Hz → 40Hz) — Mobile haptic tap motor
- `typewriter-key`: 40ms bandpassed noise clack (2500Hz) — Vintage typewriter key
- `hollow-thock`: 60ms triangle + sine decay (600Hz / 300Hz) — Wooden percussion clack

### 2. Feedback Sounds
Auditory confirmation for gestures, ratings, level-ups, and user actions.
- `blip`: 45ms sine ascending chirp (1150Hz → 2300Hz) — Focus navigation, chip select
- `hover-soft`: 50ms fixed sine pulse (820Hz) — Subtle hover states
- `zap`: 110ms lowpass sawtooth zap (1200Hz → 100Hz) — Rapid action, retro cues
- `spring`: 250ms sine frequency modulation (500Hz - 1100Hz) — Pull-to-refresh
- `bubble`: 100ms multi-stage sine pitch ramps (400Hz - 800Hz) — Likes, reactions
- `coin`: 350ms square wave arpeggio (B5 → E6) — Reward collection
- `power-up`: 400ms triangle wave chord (440Hz → 880Hz) — Upgrade, level up
- `power-down`: 450ms sawtooth sweep (300Hz → 40Hz) — Deactivation, filter reset
- `magic-sparkle`: 500ms randomized high-freq sine bursts — AI finish, magic unlock
- `jump-boing`: 350ms comical pitch envelope — Bouncy gesture, scroll top
- `arcade-pew`: 200ms retro 8-bit square pitch drop — Quick send, arcade laser
- `heartbeat`: 500ms dual-stage low-frequency pulse (50Hz → 30Hz) — Timer countdown
- `sonar-ping`: 1250ms high sine with long echoing decay (1200Hz) — Scanning, ping
- `typewriter-bell`: 850ms dual sine ring (1600Hz + 1620Hz) — Form submitted
- `synth-sweep`: 650ms sawtooth + lowpass sweep — Filter sweep, theme toggle
- `glitch`: 130ms square dropouts + bandpass noise — Error shake, static burst
- `deep-impact`: 850ms cinematic low-frequency boom — Major release confirmation
- `success-fanfare`: 650ms triangle major triad (G4, C5, E5) — Achievement unlocked

### 3. Notification Sounds
Alerts for background completions, messages, and priority updates.
- `chime`: 280ms dual-tone ascending interval (660Hz → 990Hz) — Task complete, toast
- `bell`: 300ms three-note major arpeggio (880Hz + 1100Hz + 1320Hz) — Achievement
- `ping`: 140ms curved frequency resonance (1050Hz → 1750Hz) — Push notification
- `shimmer`: 250ms multi-layered triangle chord (1.2k - 2.8kHz) — Rewards, unlocks
- `crystal`: 450ms resonant pure sine tone drop (2400Hz → 1800Hz) — Glass notification

### 4. Navigation Sounds
Spatial audio cues for route changes, drawer reveals, and sheet transitions.
- `swish`: 200ms filtered noise sweep (3200Hz → 350Hz) — Drawer slide, sheet transition
- `whoosh`: 380ms atmospheric bandpass noise sweep — Page navigation, route change
- `glissando`: 170ms smooth ascending pitch sweep (400Hz → 1200Hz) — Menu reveal
- `woosh-deep`: 450ms cinematic heavy noise sweep (100Hz → 800Hz) — Fullscreen sheet

### 5. System Sounds
Confirmation for authentication, security states, and errors.
- `lock`: 60ms dual-frequency mechanical latch (200Hz + 600Hz) — Security lock
- `unlock`: 50ms rising triangle pitch sweep (600Hz → 1400Hz) — Biometric auth
- `pulse`: 95ms sub-bass tactile pulse (65Hz) — Background sync, haptic pulse
- `error`: 180ms dissonant square alert (380Hz → 280Hz) — Form error, validation fail

## Code Examples

### Standalone Synthesis Function
```ts
export function playTap() {
  const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext)();
  const now = ctx.currentTime;
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
  const gain = ctx.createGain();

  osc.type = 'sine';
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1800, now);
  osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(700, now + 0.035);

  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.035);

  osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
  osc.start(now);
  osc.stop(now + 0.04);
}
```

### CLI Scaffolding
```bash
# Add standalone sound definitions to your project
npx @sound-library/cli add tap snap chime swish
```
